description:
NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE

Agency: Department of Veterans Affairs
Network Contracting Office: NCO 7
Carl Vinson VA Medical Center   Dublin, Georgia

Authority: FAR Part 12   Commercial Products and Services
Simplified Acquisition Procedures   FAR 13.106 1(b)(1)

NAICS Code: 333318   Other Commercial and Service Industry Machinery Manufacturing
PSC Code: 6910   Training Aids and Devices

Description of Requirement
The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to award a sole source contract to VirTra, Inc., Chandler, Arizona, for the purchase of a VirTra Virtual Training Simulator System for VA Police training. The requirement includes delivery, installation, integration, and instructor training.
The VirTra system uses proprietary hardware and simulation software designed specifically for law enforcement training environments. A manufacturer s proprietary letter confirms that the system and associated software are proprietary and available only from VirTra, Inc. or authorized distributors.
Responses
This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. Interested vendors may submit capability statements demonstrating their ability to provide the required proprietary system within five (5) calendar days of this notice.
